It restores the saved registers at the end. The referenced text is a credit line stating the program was deprotected by a named group.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0700
name: wait_for_flag_then_write
description: Spins until bit five of a word at a fixed offset from a register pointer is set, then writes a constant to a second offset from the same pointer and returns the word it observed. It performs no other operations.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0712
name: wait_for_flag_toggle
description: Waits until bit zero of a word in a structure becomes set, then waits until it becomes clear again, and returns. It performs no other operations.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0728
name: step_counter_until_limit
description: Repeatedly calls a helper, adds a fixed step to a counter in a structure, and copies a global word into two other fields. It loops until the counter reaches a fixed limit.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0746
name: decrement_counter_until_zero
description: Calls a helper, subtracts a fixed step from a counter in a structure, and copies a global word into two other fields. It repeats until the counter reaches zero.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0762
name: wait_then_increment_counter
description: Calls a helper until its result is zero, increments a counter in a structure, and repeats each step until the counter reaches fifteen.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0778
name: wait_then_decrement_counter
description: Calls a helper until its result is zero, decrements a counter in a structure, and repeats each step until the counter reaches three.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:078E
name: wait_for_register_match
description: Loops on the high byte of a word at a fixed offset from a pointer, compared with itself, so the loop condition is always true. The routine never returns under normal execution.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:07AC
name: check_serial_input_and_wait
description: If bit three of a word in a structure is set, it sets bit six of a global variable, calls a helper repeatedly while its result is nonzero, then clears that global bit. The facts record the keyboard serial data register and the CIA-A control register as touched.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:07E0
name: invoke_callback_on_condition
description: Calls a function from a global table. If the result is nonzero it calls a second function taken from the returned structure, then calls a third function from the global table. The facts also record Amiga library open and close calls.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:082C
name: open_library_and_save_fields
description: Sets a global flag from a word in a structure, opens a library through the Amiga exec library, and copies three fields from the returned library structure into global variables. It then calls three more library functions.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0880
name: execute_indirect_table_sequence
description: Calls three routines through offsets from a stored library pointer and a second global, then stores a saved value into a global variable. The facts also record a library close call and a write to the beam control register.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:08A6
name: layout_and_draw_centered_text
description: Counts the lines of a text table that ends with a marker, then computes a centred starting position from that count. It draws each line by calling a per-character routine, steps down a fixed row distance between lines, and stores the final position and end pointer in a structure.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0912
name: store_helper_result_in_field
description: Calls one helper routine and stores the address it returns into a 32-bit field of a structure.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:092E
name: spread_eight_bytes_across_rows
description: Copies eight consecutive source bytes to destination addresses spaced eighty bytes apart, writing one byte into each of eight rows. It is a column copy rather than a structure copy.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0950
name: store_two_addresses_in_struct
description: Stores the low and high words of two address values, computed from the structure base plus fixed offsets, into four word fields of that structure.

key: runtime segment $080290-$080C50:0:0972
name: clear_longword_table
description: Writes zero to each longword of a table that starts at a fixed address, for a fixed count of entries, and returns.
